svg.title: Gradient paths through time: LSTM cell state vs vanilla RNN
svg.desc: Backward along the LSTM cell state each step multiplies only by f_t; backward along a vanilla RNN each step multiplies by diag(1 - h^2) W_hh. Over 45 steps 0.99^45 = 0.636 while 0.5^45 = 2.8e-14.
svg.text: LSTM: backward along the cell state
no weight matrix, no tanh slope
Vanilla RNN: backward along the hidden state
a matrix and a slope ≤ 1 at every step
Red dashed arrows run backward in time. Other LSTM paths exist through the gates, but
they are smaller; the direct cell-state path is what keeps long gradients alive.
